errors.text_span: In beiden Diagrammen sind die Metallkategorien – Aluminium, Kupfer und Nickel – auf der horizontalen Achse in alphabetischer Reihenfolge angeordnet.
errors.evidence: The x-axis order is Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel, which is not alphabetical (alphabetical would place Kupfer before Nickel? In German, the shown order is as listed in the figure caption context and not explicitly alphabetical; the description incorrectly asserts alphabetical order as a visual property.

The description does not mention the x-axis tick/category labels as category axis labels in a structured axis description, nor does it explicitly note that the y-axis label is just '%' placed at the top of each panel; however most axis information is otherwise covered.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of two side-by-side panels/subplots with separate titles placed above each panel in blue, beyond naming the titles.
